scenarios.name: hue
scenarios.doc: The dialog's last step after a Hue bridge is added: an area is made, the lamp is named and put in it, then the bedroom (a room: its light group, scenes and sensors) and the bridge are named, and each named device's entities take the ids that follow. Then the motion sensor is named on its device page (its entities keep their ids), and named back.

scenarios.name: lifx
scenarios.doc: The dialog's last step after a LIFX bulb is added: an area is made, the bulb is named and put in it, and its enabled entities take the ids that follow. Then it is named again on its device page (its entities keep their ids), and the name is taken away.
